voice.summary: Driftboard sounds like a studio wall: casual and visual, with labels that read like sticky notes. It encourages play first and offers neat-up tools without scolding.
dos: Write labels the way people write on sticky notes
Use verbs that move things: drag, pin, snap, tidy
Announce each move in plain words
donts: Do not insist on structure; let the board be messy
Never auto-delete anything without an undo

taglines: Pin it. Move it. Make a mood
Messy now, tidy when you say
boilerplate: Driftboard is a draggable moodboard where designers pin images, notes and colour swatches, nudge them with the keyboard and keep the layout saved between visits.

microcopy.error: Could not save the board. Your layout is still here.
microcopy.empty: Nothing pinned yet. Add a note or swatch.

logo.note: A dot grid echoes the snap-to-grid surface of the board.
